description: Finds published products in this directory by words in their name, category, tagline, use case and features. Products that match every word come first, then products that match the rarer half or more of the words, each labelled with the words it matched. Optional: a category, criteria the vendor must document (from the CTI breakdown, e.g. sso, soc2, freeTrial, publicPricing), a minimum CTI score, the order (relevance, name or cti) and an offset for the next page. Returns up to 20 results with ID, name, category, CTI score and grade, the date the facts were checked and the review address. Results are matches, not a ranking or a recommendation.

category.description: Optional category ID or name (see list_categories)

documented.description: Only products whose CTI breakdown gives points for each of these criteria

match.description: best: every-word matches first, then partial ones; all: only products matching every word

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'invoice approval'

sort.description: relevance needs query words; without them the order is by name

name: search_products
title: Search products
